techniques.scion32: U1's rig (feet->body->neck->head, body->elbow->forearm->hand->note), matrices root->leaf in fixed order; poses = U1 canonical + U1 entry; in-betweens keyed by hand per ID; joint coincidence and bone-length self-check measured on every drawing (see fk_selfcheck)
techniques.scion1: on 2s; anticipation, snap with few in-betweens, overshoot, head lags the body by one drawing, 3-6 settle drawings; paper jerk = seeded +/-0.9 px frame jitter and +/-0.3 deg root jitter per drawing (zero on the final drawing); note = substitution object (back drawing -> face drawing at edge-on); the cut to black on the face-out drawing
techniques.scion29: pieces cut by U1 (cutouts.json); not re-cut here
